title: Zoom Workflow Check
user: Small web teams and accessibility consultants who need to show whether a real keyboard workflow remains operable at 200–400% browser zoom.
smallest_useful_product: Playwright-compatible CLI that records a short keyboard path, reruns it at 200% and 400%, captures focused-element visibility/clipping/scrollability, and outputs a visual HTML diff.
constraints: Use real browser zoom semantics; avoid claiming WCAG certification; screenshots remain local/CI-scoped.
